name: Fanadir Marina Gouna
headline: Captivating 1 BDR @ Fanadir Marina

description.Space:
This 1 bedroom apartment is located in Fanadir Marina, five minutes away from Abo Tig Marina. 

The apartment is on the ground floor  and features an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 2 bathrooms (one ensuite) and a living room. There is a bright and cozy outdoor terrace, perfect for your morning coffee or late night relaxation. 

It also features a 65 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channel, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples & small families.

The styling of the apartment is tailored to give the guests a relaxing vibe.


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions . Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.

agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

⚠️ THINK TWICE BEFORE BOOKING WITH XURU STAY'S ⚠️

I don’t like leaving negative reviews, but I feel compelled to share my experience. This wasn’t my first stay with Xuru Stay’s, and past issues should’ve been a warning. One stay had an unfixed leak—despite my patience and tolerance, they told me to put a cooking pot under it. Another property had immediate issues on arrival.

I didn’t realise this latest booking was also with them, or I would've avoided it. Upon arrival, I wanted to cancel and requested a full refund through Airbnb after immediately inspecting the apartment due to doubts and took photo and video evidence for Airbnb to review. 

What I found:

Poor overall condition
Not properly cleaned
Worn furnishings
Hairs on bathroom/floor surfaces
Crumbs under sofa throws
Dust and dirt on floors
Crusty cooker
Smeared surfaces

I wish I could share the photos here. Please do think twice before booking with Xuru Stay’s.

I did book another stay and the difference was remarkable.

Overall okay as the house itself is nice. But the place was so dusty when we checked in. The floor ledges, plants, decor pieces and bathroom windows were very dusty. The floor and balcony looked like it had been wiped with a dirty mop. And bathroom mats and toilet papers were not provided. I called them as soon as I walked in to get a re-clean of the place. They kindly obliged but their cleaning standards were low. I supervised the cleaning for the next 3 hours of me checking in before the place felt habitable. No hot water in the showers either. But they were apologetic about the mess and gave me some compensation for the time wasted. They seem to take my feedback with care and say they’ll improve in the future. So if you do stay with them just be prepared for some back and forth about cleanliness.
Everything was great apart from not having hot water for the entire stay. I would offer more than a 4hr complimentary late check out for such an issue.
